checks.message: Provisional boundary is explicitly identified as low-confidence and non-statutory; official geometry is still required before precision or approval use.
All three required key areas are present and explicitly marked as provisional rough substitutes.
Twelve land-use units form a complete, non-overlapping partition of the submitted provisional site.
Design geometry includes 62 concept building units, 10 mobility lines, four green spaces, three public nodes and attributed OSM context.
Known spatial metrics are recalculated in EPSG:4548; unsupported FAR, floor area, height and road area remain unknown.
Offline HTML includes all required sections and matching metrics without remote dependencies, forms or tracking.
Proposal references all six standards, 15 design-depth items, seven known metrics and all required machine-readable layers.
Each primary, provisional, OSM and case-study source records usable and prohibited purposes; governance assumptions require human review.
